extension.name: Enkrypt Secure MCP Gateway configuration removal review
extension.description: Locally opt-in HOL-authored review for secure-mcp-gateway config remove, which removes a gateway configuration. Independent extension; Enkrypt AI does not maintain, distribute, or endorse it.

permissions.label: Review MCP gateway configuration removal
permissions.description: Request review before deleting a named or identified MCP gateway configuration using the official secure-mcp-gateway CLI.
safer_guidance: Inspect the exact gateway configuration with secure-mcp-gateway config get before deleting it.
Export the target configuration with secure-mcp-gateway config export so that recovery remains possible.
